notes.title: Martian Law - New Build Is Live! - Difficulty Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35667842/cdf2df20ddc43c46c352fe71e9b91322a3cc05ea.png[/img]

We appreciate all the feedback we have been getting from our players. We realized difficulty was an issue that needed to be addressed.

In the latest build we made a couple adjustments to help the game's difficulty. Level unlocks and achievements should be a little easier to reach now.

Martian Law will continue to be FREE on Steam (PC) until April 10th. 

Thank you for playing. Take care of each other and please stay safe.

notes.title: Martian Law - Steam Achievements
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35667842/894bb6721f69f6ca60d41b57922b6adfae95d9b6.jpg[/img]

We recently added some Steam achievements to Martian Law. Here is what we got so far:
[list]
[*] Little Martian that Could (Save 100 Martians) 
[*] Iron Fields (Unlock Level 2)
[*] Come Get Some (Save 400 Martians)
[*] Capital City (Unlock Level 3)
[*] Always Bet on Green (Save 700 Martians)
[*] Welcome to Mars (Save 1000 Martians)
[/list]
'Welcome to Mars' is a very difficult achievement. We have yet to unlock it in a natural playthrough...but we know it can be done.

Martian Law will be [b]available on Steam on October 18, 2019[/b]. Add it to your wishlist!

notes.title: Martian Law - Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35667842/50a69e63ed8cd1d89e777a6c97d0b8a8f7f6d463.png[/img]

Linclo Games is excited to announce [b]Martian Law will launch on Steam on October 18th![/b] We have been working tirelessly to get the gameplay tight. We really think you are going to enjoy this little arcade experience.

We recently added a couple of new features:
[list]
[*] Steam Leaderboards
[*] Steam Achievements
[/list]
Linclo Games is a small indie studio and we appreciate your support. Our players are our top priority and we couldn't do this without you. Please let us know if you have any questions about the game.
